title: hand-written codecs decode and encode nested values with optional members
purpose: Codecs are plain objects over Json: optional members read as the given fallback when absent or null; reading errors keep the pointer of the failing value.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.3.1 (json/codec); rewritten for the json module (Json.optional, Json.list)
provenance.expected_basis: null note and absent qty/tags take their fallbacks ("-", 1, []); 12.50 and 1e2 are written positionally as 12.5 and 100; a string qty is JsonError.wrong_kind at /0/lines/0/qty; absent lines read by list() is JsonError.missing at /0/lines.
